name: Sahil Langoo
title: Full Stack Systems Engineer & Systems Architect
bio: Full Stack Systems Engineer at Eresolution Consultancy Services & Co-Founder at SquadCoders. Architecting ultra-fast static web architectures, distributed edge proxies, and local AI pipelines.
about: Full Stack Systems Engineer with a B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering (2020-2023, CGPA: 7.07, Capstone: Listify) from the University of Kashmir following a 3-Year Diploma in Computer Science Engineering from Kashmir Govt Polytechnic (2016-2019, CGPA: 6.22), currently engineering systems at Eresolution Consultancy Services and Co-Founder at SquadCoders. Specializes in crafting high-performance, responsive web architectures, distributed edge computing proxies, and AI integrations. Dedicated to building software that is fast by default, zero-waste, and engineered with strict type safety.

principles.title: KISS & YAGNI
principles.description: Simplicity over premature abstraction. Build what is needed with precision and zero unnecessary dependencies.

principles.title: Performance by Default
principles.description: Static HTML generation first, Partytown worker offloading, zero main-thread block, 0.00 CLS, and instant global TTFB.

principles.title: Tactile UI Craft
principles.description: High-contrast typography, calibrated OKLCH color systems, and responsive micro-interactions (scale on press, smooth scroll).

principles.title: Type Safety & Quality Gates
principles.description: End-to-end type safety, Zod runtime schema validation, and automated build-time link and asset verification.
